build_MLANeck: build a Multi-level Feature Aggregation neck module for vision transformer backbones using SETR construction
build_MLAModule: build an MLA module with channel projection and feature extraction convolutions for multi-scale features
run_MLANeck_forward: run the MLANeck forward pass to normalize inputs and aggregate multi-level features
run_MLAModule_forward: run the MLAModule forward pass to project channels, accumulate features, and extract outputs
review_MLANeck: review the MLANeck class that converts NCHW to NLC, applies layer norm, then runs MLA aggregation
